1:-- Copy to: ~/.hammerspoon/local_whisper_actions.lua
2:-- Voice commands for local-whisper dictation.
3:-- All commands start with "voice command" to prevent false matches on normal speech.
4:--
5:-- Hooks:
6:--   beforeInsert(ctx)  -> runs before text insertion
7:--   actions = { ... }  -> ordered list of actions
8:--   afterInsert(ctx)   -> runs after insertion
9:--
10:-- Context fields:
11:--   ctx.text, ctx.textLower, ctx.originalText
12:--   ctx.lang, ctx.outputMode
13:--   ctx.appName, ctx.appBundleID   -- app that was focused when recording started
14:--   ctx.insert, ctx.inserted, ctx.handled
15:--   ctx.timestamp, ctx.isoTime     -- when the dictation was recorded
16:--
17:-- Context methods:
18:--   ctx:setText("new text")
19:--   ctx:disableInsert(), ctx:enableInsert()
20:--   ctx:launchApp("Safari")
21:--   ctx:appendToFile(path, line)
22:--   ctx:runShell("command", optionalInputText)
23:--   ctx:keystroke({"cmd"}, "a")      -- fire a keystroke
24:--   ctx:notify("message"), ctx:log("message")
25:--
26:-- Patterns match against ctx.textLower (case-insensitive).
27:-- Set ctx.handled = true in any hook to skip remaining actions.
28:-- Config auto-reloads when the file changes.
33:    beforeInsert = function(ctx)
35:        -- "voice command cancel/abort" — can appear anywhere in the text
45:        -- All other commands require "voice command" at the start
49:        -- "voice command note <anything>" — save to ~/whisper_notes.md
61:        -- "voice command remind <anything>" — create a macOS Reminder
79:        -- "voice command open app <name>" — launch or focus an app
91:        -- "voice command select all" — Cmd+A
99:        -- "voice command copy" — Cmd+C
108:        -- "voice command paste" — Cmd+V
116:        -- "voice command undo" — Cmd+Z
128:    afterInsert = function(ctx)
